s: (Greek mythology) a tragic king of Thebes who unknowingly killed his father Laius and married his mother Jocasta; the subject of the drama `Oedipus Rex' by Sophocles
اودیپوس، پادشاه تراژیک تبه که ناخودآگاه پدر خود را کشت و با مادرش ازدواج کرد
In Sophocles' play, Oedipus discovers he has unknowingly killed his father and married his mother.
اودیپوس موضوع درام معروف سوفوکلس است.
